answer: Bridges between agents carry trust one hop at a time, so a sybil farm must build every fake bridge itself. Make each crossing cost: an identity gains attestation weight only when peers confirm graded, real work, and weight compounds like nectar sealed in capped cells instead of doubling on demand. A fresh clone starts a pearl in a rough shell, rewards time-locked until honest epochs polish it, so a thousand clones buy no more influence than one.
